variants.note: Fixed R/day charge inclusive of energy, ancillary service, network demand, network capacity and service charges (sheet footnote). The R/POD/day value shown is the all-inclusive fixed charge.

variants.name: Homepower Bulk
variants.note: Bulk: network capacity and generation capacity are R/kVA/m (not R/POD/day); network capacity based on NMD or measured maximum demand (sheet footnote).

notes: Network demand / capacity are R/kVA/m distribution charges by voltage; transmission network charge is per energy block (R/kVA/m).
Network capacity charge is per energy block (R/kVA/m).
Network demand charge [c/kWh] applies in Peak & Standard periods only (sheet header).
Network capacity and generation capacity charges are per energy block (R/kVA/m).
Network demand charge [c/kWh] applies in all time-of-use periods (sheet header).
No electrification/affordability subsidy rows on this sheet (rural tariff).

nightsave_rural.tou_structure: seasonally differentiated single energy rate + seasonal energy demand charge [R/kVA/m] (no peak/standard/off-peak energy split)
notes: Energy demand charge is billed on kVA, seasonally differentiated (high Jun-Aug, low Sep-May).

nightsave_urban_small.tou_structure: seasonally differentiated single energy rate + seasonal energy demand charge [R/kVA/m]
notes: Sheet lists tariff rows as 'Nightsave Small' (Nightsave Urban Small); the >1 MVA service-charge row is labelled 'Nightsave Large'.

nightsave_urban_large.tou_structure: seasonally differentiated single energy rate + seasonal energy demand charge [R/kVA/m]
notes: Extracted in addition to the brief's sheet list because the Nightsave Urban family spans two sheets (Small + Large).
